title: Sample-Query Interconversion of Block Encoding of Unknown Quantum States
summary: Block encoding embeds a matrix as a sub-block of a unitary matrix and serves as a fundamental input model for quantum algorithms based on quantum singular value transformation, enabling polynomial transformations of matrices encoded in unitary operators. Block encoding of unknown quantum states can be useful for quantum learning; however, the fundamental limits on converting between unknown quantum states and their block-encoding unitary channels remain poorly understood.
